decision: Selected the facility coordinate the applicant gives in Section 1-D of its initial NSR air-permit application (latitude 31.980569, longitude -108.511384; County: Grant; elevation 4,540 ft). It locates the proposed gas-engine power plant of the Site Layer 1 Data Center Project, which the preliminary layout (Figure 2 of the modeling report) draws beside the four planned data-centre buildings; it is not a surveyed building, parcel or the 7,214.4-acre generation project area.

section_1D_utm.datum_checked_on_form: NAD 83 (WGS 84 box unchecked; read from the rendered form page)

computed.method: Section 1-D UTM converted from NAD83 / UTM zone 12N (EPSG:26912) to NAD83 geographic with pyproj 3.7.1; geodesic distances on WGS84 (pyproj Geod). The applicant point is used as published.
computed.coordinate_reference_system: NAD83 decimal degrees as published in Section 1-D (NAD 83 box checked; the modeling also uses NAD83 UTM zone 12N); used without transformation, as NAD83 and WGS84 differ by about 1 m here.

caveats: The preliminary layout sheet (Figure 2) carries a title block naming a different, solar project and a coordinate 18.6 km to the south-east; the application form, public-notice letters and modeled engine stacks all place the facility at the selected point, so the title block is treated as a drafting carry-over. The data-centre buildings are drawn adjacent to the engine plant but are not given coordinates.
